skill_rule_red: These folders stay on this computer and are never read or sent: {paths}.
skill_rule_language: Answer in the language the person writes in.
skill_examples: Examples of good answers are in examples.json beside this file.
plugin_readme: The Claude skills of {company}, written with firmcall. Each skill is one task the people of the company do often.
rollout_intro: The steps for the person who sets AI up for the company. Each step says how long it takes.
rollout_catalogue: Make the private catalogue a repository (5 minutes): in `{folder}` run `git init`, `git add -A`, `git commit -m "first"`, then `gh repo create --private --source . --push`. The repository name must be the one written in `managed/managed-settings.d/50-company.json`.
rollout_tests: Run the skills' tests (1 minute): `python3 -m pytest -q tests` in `{folder}`. Green before anyone gets it.
rollout_device: Put the rules on one computer (2 minutes): `sudo sh managed/install.sh` on a Mac or Linux, `managed/install.ps1` in an administrator PowerShell on Windows.
rollout_jamf: Many Macs (10 minutes): upload `managed/jamf/{slug}.mobileconfig` as a configuration profile in Jamf, and `managed/jamf/claude-files.sh` as a policy script for the same computers.
rollout_intune: Many Windows laptops (10 minutes): Intune > Devices > Scripts and remediations > Platform scripts > Add, the script `managed/intune/{script}`, run as system, 64-bit.
rollout_console: Cloud sessions (5 minutes): paste `managed/server-managed-settings.json` into claude.ai > Organization settings > Claude Code > Managed settings. The device file keeps working where a session goes to another model endpoint.
rollout_cowork: Cowork and chat (5 minutes): claude.ai > Organization settings > Plugins & skills: add the repository, or upload `{zip}`, and set it to Installed by default.
rollout_remote: The phone remote (2 minutes): claude.ai/admin-settings/claude-code, turn Remote Control on; for Trusted Devices, Organization settings > Capabilities > Remote sessions.
rollout_check: Check one computer (2 minutes): start Claude Code, run `/status` - Setting sources names the managed settings - and `/plugin` lists the company's plugin.
rollout_mcp: MCP servers: `claude mcp list` shows the company's servers; each person signs in to them with their own account.
rollout_rls: The database (10 minutes): run `managed/rls.sql` as the database owner; the agent then reads only each person's own rows.
next: Next: read {out}/ROLLOUT.md, then run: firmcall check {out}
